Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Migrate from PHP/JSON backend to Supabase

Replace the PHP admin panel and JSON file storage with a full Supabase
backend. All storefront pages now fetch data client-side via the Supabase
JS SDK \(preserving static export\). Includes new checkout flow, order
management, and a complete admin panel with Supabase Auth.

- Add Supabase client, types, services, and custom useSupabaseQuery hook
- Rewrite storefront pages \(home, shop, collections, product, cart, status\)
- Add checkout page with order creation and order-success confirmation
- Build admin panel: dashboard, products CRUD, categories CRUD, orders,
  settings, image upload to Supabase Storage
- Add AdminAuthContext \(Supabase Auth\) and AdminShell with sidebar nav
- Add ToastProvider \(react-hot-toast\) for admin notifications
- Create database schema \(supabase/schema.sql\) and migration script
- Remove legacy PHP admin, backend scripts, and duplicate product routes
- Update ProductCard to accept both /images/ and https:// Supabase URLs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
